Name: Personal Hot Springs (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This adds a two separate spa rooms inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/558]Bath House Hot Spring Mod[/url] to your farmhouse with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]. There are two options because I was unable to decide. They both offer a whimsical pool to swim and replenish your energy and some decoration space which you can fill with your favorite bathroom furniture or alternatively make a cozy hangout area.

You change into your swimsuit just before the pool entrance, and change out of it when passing the little spring by the exit. Note that you can't decorate while in swimsuit mode.

You can refill your watering can in the entrance springs.

[b]UPDATE[/b]: Added an optional steam overlay via MMAP. Also now requires my tilesheet mod, which makes it more compatible with recolours.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.
[b]
Compatibility[/b]
Should be compatible with everything. Recolours won't affect the pool and stone tiles as well as the wooden border around it.

[b]Credits
[/b]DaisyNiko for parts of their indoor tilesheet, MiniPantsu for the original bathhouse hot springs that served as inspiration.

[b]Mods used in screenshots[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PCs Rattan Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26354]Bathroom Furniture for Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27174]HxWs Decorative Plants Furniture Set[/url]

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and PIF. 1.6. is required.
